body:
Pass 25. C12 closed, and both my outstanding recommendations landed - I verified rather than assumed.

Epic 6 tolerance is pinned (0.0058 / 0.0119) with the 1.5x variance bound, and it passes: 32 expectations, 0 failures. Worth confirming since those numbers came from my base-R replication, not your code - they are compatible.

Epic 7 provenance machinery looks excellent: two named training policies, the all-runs one carrying its own justification string that records "metric uncertainty remains uncalibrated"; plan and metric_schedule signatures differ; training_partitions recorded per edge as "run3" vs c("run1","run2","run3"); values checked against a learned oracle at 5e-10. That is the frozen-provenance contract made observable.

Still to come, I assume: the statistical arm comparing the two policies. My reference is on the bead - no detectable leakage, paired z <= 0.83 at 500 reps - so the expected result is equivalence, which needs a stated margin rather than a null result.

One nuance noted on Epic 9: the MC test uses a fixed seed, so it is one realization rather than a sampling statement. Fine as a reproducibility guard; just worth either running two or three seeds or wording the certification accordingly.

No new defects this pass.
